author: Numberz_
body:
Hey, im not sure if you guys punish for web bans the same was as in game, but Orbb_ has been using alts on the forums recently. I've noticed activity while checking the Proxy team page. Two of his known alts have recently accepted invites to that team. Also at the time of writing this another one of his accounts was just online on the forums. If you could possibly IP check (if that works on the forums) to confirm my claim. 

I will list the accounts I know of below.

https://avicus.net/PaladinGaming87
https://avicus.net/AbstractPenguin

Thank you in advance. <3
